description: This is a PHP unit test class for the LeaveTypeDao class, part of the OrangeHRM leave management plugin. The file contains test cases verifying CRUD operations, retrieval, and search functionalities for leave types within the HRM system.

classes.name: LeaveTypeDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveTypeDao functions in the OrangeHRM HR management system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, creating a new instance of LeaveTypeDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Verifies that the DAO retrieves the expected list of leave types.

methods.name: _getLeaveTypeObjectWithValues
methods.description: Creates and returns a LeaveType object with preset values for testing save operations.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveTypeReturnValue
methods.description: Tests that saving a LeaveType returns the correct object with assigned ID.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveTypeCheckSavedType
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the leave type saved to the database.

methods.name: testDeleteLeaveTypeReturnValue
methods.description: Tests the delete operation on leave types, checking the returned count.

methods.name: testDeleteLeaveTypeValues
methods.description: Checks if a leave type is marked as deleted after deletion.

methods.name: testDeleteLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of deleted leave types list.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListObjectTypes
methods.description: Ensures the list of deleted leave types contains only LeaveType objects.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of deleted leave types.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListInverseResult
methods.description: Checks that deleted leave types do not include the expected non-deleted IDs or names.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListValuesAndOrder
methods.description: Checks the specific order and values of deleted leave types.

methods.name: testUndeleteLeaveTypeReturnValue
methods.description: Verifies that undelete operation returns a LeaveType object with unmarked deletion.

methods.name: testUndeleteLeaveTypeValues
methods.description: Checks value correctness of leave type after undeletion.

methods.name: testUndeleteLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Verifies the resume of leave types after undeletion.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByNameType
methods.description: Checks retrieval of leave type by name; expects null if none found.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByNameValues
methods.description: Confirms correct properties are returned for a leave type by name.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByIdObjectType
methods.description: Tests retrieval of leave types by ID, including deleted types.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByIdObjectWrongArgument
methods.description: Verifies null is returned when invalid ID is used.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByIdValues
methods.description: Checks that properties of leave type match expected values.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListObjectTypes
methods.description: Ensures all items in list are of class LeaveType.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListCount
methods.description: Checks count of all leave types.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListInverseResult
methods.description: Verifies that the list does not contain certain IDs or names.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListValuesAndOrder
methods.description: Checks order and specific values of the leave type list.

methods.name: _compareLeaveTypes
methods.description: Helper method to compare expected and actual leave type arrays.

methods.name: _compareLeaveType
methods.description: Helper method to compare individual LeaveType objects.

methods.name: testGetSearchLeaveTypesCount
methods.description: Tests the count of leave types matching search filters.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveType
methods.description: Tests search functionality returning leave types matching no specific filter.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveTypeSearchByName
methods.description: Tests search functionality filtering by leave type name.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveTypeWithLimit
methods.description: Tests search with limit parameter to restrict number of results.
